explanation: Matches the first question on erdosproblems.com/1187 with the positive answer from Green–Tao: for every k ≥ 3 and every finite colouring of ℤ there is a monochromatic k-term AP consisting of primes. Set.IsAPOfLength k is a set of exactly k terms, so the progression is nontrivial. The pigeonhole argument on the colour classes of the primes, followed by the relative-density Green–Tao theorem, gives it.
